title: Chapter 1228
text:
At the same time, the other Primordial Ones who were remotely monitoring the fleet were all stunned. Disbelief filled their faces, and displeasure appeared in their eyes.

"Hey, did I hear wrongly? He wants to challenge Pangon and the other four?" Someone was confused.

"Isn't he a little too arrogant? From what he said just now, I thought he had enough self-awareness. "

"Heh, looks like his ambition is indeed not small. He even wants to show us who's boss." Someone sneered.

"To think he can think of something like that. I remember that he defeated more than ten Beyond Grade As during the Godlike War. Could it be that this made him overconfident?"

"That's possible. Maybe he thinks our strength is on the same level as modern Beyond Grade As … Heh, just because he bullied little kids who grew up in a peaceful era, he really thinks he's strong? He probably hasn't seen a true top expert before. "

"Such arrogance angered Pangon and the others. They definitely won't let this go. There's going to be a good show to watch." Someone gloated. "Just wait, they'll teach this guy a lesson, especially Pangon … He has a bad temper."

"Let's hope he can maintain this arrogant look later," someone said with a mocking tone.

Hearing this, everyone could not help but smile as though they were waiting to watch a good show.

These words were targeted at all the Primordial Ones, and it also provoked them. Most of them did not seem to care, but they were actually very angry and could not wait to see Han Xiao suffer.

…

On the other side, when Oathkeeper, Pangon, and the other four heard Han Xiao's words, their expressions changed again.

Saying that we're outdated and not letting go of the glory of the past? That's a little hurtful!

"You overestimate yourself!"

Pangon's expression was ugly. Flames of anger flashed in his eyes.

When had they ever been underestimated like that in the age when they dominated the universe?

This was the first time someone had spoken to them like that!

Even Oathkeeper felt a little awkward, feeling like he had been scolded as well.

Feeling the tense atmosphere, he could not help but sweat for Han Xiao.

Oathkeeper hoped that Black Star would teach his companions a lesson. However, Black Star actually wanted to fight five of them alone. This was beyond his expectations, and it gave him a fright. He was always worried that the situation would turn upside down.

"Black Star is too arrogant. Can he …"

Oathkeeper was a little regretful. He thought that Black Star did not know much about the strength of these Primordial Ones, which was why he had made such a request.

In his eyes, although Black Star was powerful, he was not that powerful. Although he had caught up on the news during this period, his impression of Han Xiao was still the same as before he entered the Sanctum.

If he had known, he would have informed Black Star beforehand and revealed some information. These five fellows were not ordinary Beyond Grade As …

At this moment, Beiger narrowed his eyes and repeatedly confirmed, "Are you sure you want to fight the five of us?"

"What's wrong? You're not willing?" Han Xiao's gaze swept across everyone's faces, taking in their expressions.

"There's no need for that." Mei Ji frowned and said calmly, "If the five of us fight together, it won't be praiseworthy even if we win … Are you afraid of a one-on-one battle and worried that your reputation will be damaged? I can promise you that our sparring will not go too far. We just want to test your ability. No matter what the result is, we'll consider it a draw. Are you satisfied? "

"You guys are quite considerate of me." Han Xiao smiled.

"No matter what, you're our benefactor. I …"

Before Mei Ji could finish, Pangon interrupted her and said coldly, "Don't represent me. I want to deal with him alone."

Hearing this, Han Xiao's smile did not change. "Let's fight together. It's a waste of energy to fight one by one. I don't like to take turns."

Everyone's expression froze, and they were furious.

We gave you a way out, but you didn't take it. Instead, you're pushing it.

You're f * cking asking for a beating!

Beiger looked at Han Xiao deeply. "You chose this yourself."

"I said, I alone am enough." Pangon turned to look at his other companions, looking like he was about to start an internal conflict.

"Just treat it as us watching from the side." Another person knew Pangon's personality well, so he spoke to ease the atmosphere.

Pangon thought about it and did not object. He stomped his feet on the ground, and a huge force spread out with him as the center. Sand waves rippled on the ground.

Bang!

He shot up into the sky and flew into outer space impatiently.

The other four were not surprised and followed him. Pugilists were all stubborn and not very smart. They were already used to Pangon's style and could not be bothered with his attitude.

You have triggered the hidden mission [Fist Is the Last Word]!

Mission Introduction: The awakened Primordial Ones thank you for your help, but they are not convinced. You have decided to show your strength and gain the respect of the Primordial Ones.

Mission Requirements: Use actions to gain the respect of the Primordial Ones.

Reward: Based on your actions and results, the higher the rating, the better the reward.

"Yo, it's out. This should be the same series of missions as [Return to the Historical Stage]."

Han Xiaoxin's heart skipped a beat.

He browsed through the missions while flying into outer space. He immediately saw that the four of them had already gotten into formation. The four of them were very far away from each other, standing in different directions and defining the battlefield. Meanwhile, Pangon remained in the field, facing each other.

"Can you make a move now?" Pangon sounded anxious.

"I can at any time …"

Before Han Xiao could finish his sentence, Pangon had already lost his patience. Golden red flames burst out of his body, turning into a meteor and charging toward him.

Normally, when Pugilists and Mechanics were sparring, they would take the initiative to open up some distance and let the Mechanic release a portion of his army first. However, Pangon had experienced countless large-scale galactic wars and had long formed a habit. As long as he had a slight advantage, he would expand it infinitely. Even if it was a sparring session, he would not give in at all.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes. He stayed where he was and opened the secondary dimensional army box. Before the first batch of mechanical troops appeared, Pangon crashed into his firm chest.

Boom!

The fist landed right on his chest. Pangon's eyes sparkled. He did not expect Han Xiao to not dodge and immediately switched from a normal attack to a Pugilist technique. Dense Pugilist flames were injected into Han Xiao's body through the fist, turning into a shockwave and exploding.

This was a control-type skill, using the Pugilist flames to cause the molecules in the opponent's body to vibrate. As long as the opponent's strength was enough to crush the opponent, he would be able to temporarily take control of the opponent's body.

Pangon was very experienced in dealing with high-level Mechanics. He knew that this was a rare opportunity, so he would not let go of this opportunity. Combo after combo after combo flashed through his mind, and he instantly chose the most explosive combo. His body immediately moved according to muscle memory. He only needed to wait for Han Xiao to be controlled, and he would immediately hit him with a combo to deal full damage.

However, he did not wait for Han Xiao to lose control. Just as he was about to use the starting martial arts of his combo, a huge slap suddenly came flying towards his face.

Pa!

This slap was so powerful that Pangon's eyes popped out. His head buzzed from the slap, and he could almost hear the sound of his facial bones cracking.

Before he recovered from the momentary dizziness, the close-range attacks suddenly hit him like a storm. Countless heavy attacks landed on his body every second, shattering the golden-red flames that protected his body one after another. His muscles rippled and caved in continuously. The excruciating pain swept through every nerve like a tide.

Pangon instinctively raised his hand to block, protecting his vitals. His mind was still a little dazed.

Wait a minute, a Mechanic was closed in by a Pugilist like me, but not only did he not retreat, he even took the initiative to fight back?

It's fine if he fought back, but what's with this strength? It's ridiculously strong!

After being chased and beaten up by Han Xiao for a few seconds, Pangon finally found an opening. He twisted Han Xiao's arm and pulled him into his arms. He then wrapped his arms around Han Xiao and formed a lock.

"Don't even think about running!"

Pangon spat out a mouthful of bloody saliva. The Pugilist flames stimulated his body, and his muscles suddenly bulged. His body expanded, and his strength increased exponentially.

He was ready to wrestle and planned to stop Han Xiao from breaking free from his lock.

As long as he could lock Han Xiao for two seconds, he would be able to prepare a powerful skill and unleash an even more violent combo.

Every part of a high-level Pugilist's body was a weapon. Although Pangon was a little dazed by Han Xiao's counterattack, as long as he reacted, with his countless Pugilist skills and talents, he would have an incomparable advantage in close combat.

However, the next moment, his expression froze, and shock flashed through his eyes. Not only did he not feel Han Xiao's struggle, but he even realized that Han Xiao had wrapped his arm around his waist and formed a lock.

"What kind of fighting style is this?" Even though Pangon was very knowledgeable, he was still a little dumbfounded.

"You want to learn? Unfortunately, you won't be able to learn it even if I teach you. "Han Xiao chuckled.

At this moment, the first batch of mechanical troops that had just flown out of the secondary dimension opened fire at the two people hugging each other without hesitation. In their preset program, the highest priority tactic was that as long as their master caught a target, they would unconditionally open fire at their master. There was no need to actively control them.

Seeing this scene, Pangon's expression changed.

Isn't this a mutual destruction tactic? Damn it, this person is even fiercer than me!

As the saying goes, the unreasonable are afraid of the reckless, and the reckless are afraid of the reckless. Although his physique was tough, he did not want to take a psionic bath with his enemy. A layer of his flesh would be washed off!

Pangon hurriedly let go of his hand and wanted to retreat. However, his waist was tightly held by Han Xiao's arm. Han Xiao's strength was so great that he could not break free for a while.

"Don't waste your energy. I'm really curious. You knew that I was coming to visit half a month ago, but you didn't go online to check my information. If you had carefully studied my battle video, you wouldn't have stupidly rushed to my face … Do you have to be so arrogant? Or did Oathkeeper cut you off from the internet? "

Han Xiao was a little speechless.

He really did not plan to use this move because he felt that as long as the Primordial Ones studied his information online, this traditional skill would not work. At the very least, after seeing the nickname 'Indestructible Body', they would be more or less on guard.

However, he did not expect an iron-headed girl to come and find him right from the start. Even he did not underestimate his enemy and constructed a data model of his opponent in advance. This only proved that these Primordial Ones did not take him seriously at all.

Then don't blame me. You're the one who delivered yourself to me.

"Eat my old and fresh hands — all of you! Go! Yellow! Spring! "

Boom! Boom! Boom!

The light of the psionic cannons' explosions instantly drowned the two of them.

The bombardment lasted for two to three seconds. A golden-red meteor hurriedly escaped from the explosion area and rolled for a long distance in space before stopping.

Pangon's clothes were ragged, and he was in a sorry state. Large patches of his body were charred, and some parts of his body were emitting high heat, showing signs of carbonization.

At this time, Han Xiao also flew out of the explosion area. He sized Pangon up and sighed regretfully.

The army had not been assembled for long, and the first batch of mechanical soldiers was too little. The damage was far from enough. After the damage of the focus fire was reduced by various shields and resistances, Pangon was only slightly injured at most.

Han Xiao had already seen Pangon's interface from the combat information. Pangon's Energy Rank was around 71,000, and his attributes were about the same as Han Xiao's when he was Level 300. Before his Promotion, it might have taken him some effort to deal with Pangon, but now, he could totally beat him up in all sorts of ways.

However, he also understood that these Primordial Ones were not at their peak. The Weakness period and the loss of part of their abilities were only one of the reasons. Another important reason was that although these people had awakened, their equipment would not appear together with them. For example, half of Pangon's nickname came from the equipment set he wore when he fought in the galaxy. It was also called 'King of War', and it was made by the civilization he was in. There were a total of three Universal Treasures in it — a shield, a spear, and an armor. Without this equipment, his strength would decrease by about twenty to thirty percent.

This was especially true for the awakened Mechanics. Without all their assets, they would have to start from scratch. Not everyone had the terrifying production capabilities of the Mecha Empire like him.

Seeing this scene, the four people at the side were shocked. They put away their careless attitude and their expressions became serious.

"Did you see that? The strength that guy just displayed?"

"Hmm, a Mechanic who should be physically weak actually has such high Strength and Dexterity. Either his Energy Rank is much higher than Pangon's, resulting in his foundation being so strong, or the path of modern Mechanics is so wild that they chose to train their physique instead of learning mechanics!"

"I think the possibility of the latter is quite high …"

While the few of them were communicating in the communication channel, the situation in the field changed again. Pangon had suffered a small loss and was afraid to attack. Before he figured out the situation, he did not dare to continue attacking. He did not know where to start.

However, Han Xiao did not take the opportunity to chase after him. He shot out a net-like golden Mechanical Force that covered the mechanical army like a net, pulling all of them toward him. In the dazzling Mechanical Force lightning, the enormous Mechanical Deity appeared out of nowhere.

The next moment, the Mechanical Deity dragged the Celestial Punishment Edge, circled around, and threw out a silver-blue psionic blade wave.

Swoosh!

The blade light spread out rapidly, and even the four people on the edge of the battlefield became the targets of the attack. Light flashed, and magic formations, Esper Abilities, psychic abilities, and other means appeared at the same time. Beiger, Mei Ji, and the others used their abilities to block the powerful blade wave.

At the same time, Han Xiao's teasing voice sounded in the public channel. "I said I'll fight five, so I'll definitely fight five. You want to watch the show from the side? Dream on! "

Beiger and the others looked at each other. Without any hesitation, they joined the battle together.

After seeing what Black Star was capable of, the few of them did not mind fighting five against one. If Pangon fought one on one, he would most likely lose. Furthermore, Han Xiao had initiated the attack and forced them to attack, so it would be inappropriate for them to not fight back.

The few of them did not mind fighting together. During the exploration era, it was normal to fight many times. If they were too particular, they would end up being killed by the enemy. The Primordial Ones were all used to fighting one person in a group, so they would not have any psychological barriers to this.

"You guys are finally not so pretentious. Come, let me give you guys a good beating and help you see the truth!"

Seeing this, Han Xiao grinned. The Mechanical Deity spun the Celestial Punishment Edge and charged toward the five of them.
